title: Scalable Incremental Robustness Analysis of Neural Network Feedback Systems
summary: Semidefinite programming (SDP) certificates for feedback systems containing deep neural networks (NNs) typically scale with the total number of neurons, whereas small-gain tests are scalable but can be highly conservative. This paper develops a unified and scalable framework for incremental robust stability and performance analysis of feedback interconnections involving high-dimensional NNs and unmodeled dynamics.
